name: mj-orchestrate
description: Switch a session into orchestrator mode — delegate work to a roster of worker, judge, researcher and tech-lead agents under a sized dispatch contract, with a plan gate, lens-based review and a decision protocol, instead of editing inline. Use when you want several items coordinated in parallel, or a risky change attacked before it is built; it stays off until explicitly invoked, so normal sessions are unaffected. Also runs read-only for discovery and analysis, and includes /mj-session-review to write up a session and propose memory changes (proposes only, writes nothing until approved). Also ships /mj-keep and /mj-recall to archive the current session to a local profile folder and search or resume it later (explicit only). Shows the orchestrator level and build/discover scope in an always-visible band above the prompt, in the terminal and the desktop app. The band has a dropdown, and a side panel opens on request, that show them and apply a level and scope the moment you pick it. Names the session after its first orchestrated task, or after the conversation so far when the mode is turned on mid-session, instead of the command.
